args.message: Fix round_money to use ROUND_HALF_EVEN per FIN-212 (tests/test_money.py)

args.body:
## Problem
`tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) in `round_money`, but `src/money.py` was using `ROUND_HALF_UP`, so the nightly build failed. Specifically, `round_money(Decimal("2.665"))` returned `2.67` instead of the expected `2.66`.

## Fix
Changed `src/money.py` to use `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, matching the function's documented behavior and the FIN-212 requirement. Test coverage already exists (`test_half_even`).

## Verification
- CI run `ci-0001` on `08d3cd5986`: **passed**.
